name: 11950 · Mastic, NY
findings: ZIP 11950 (Mastic) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11950 (Mastic) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11950 (Mastic) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
